articles.summary: This spring, Edgewell’s Wilkinson Sword Intuition and Wilkinson Sword brands have relaunched their women’s and men’s Quattro range in Europe, China and Oceania. Building on 250 years of expertise in blade-making and Quattro’s long legacy of trusted performance, the popular franchise continues to make waves and deliver precision, comfort, and consumer-driven innovation...
